机制概述: Hikaru has 4 distinct Element Tokens. He can use these for different effects and gain them back over the course of the duel. Use them to power up his attacks at the right time.

效果.效果: Use an Element. The used Element cannot be regained this beat. Fire: +3 Power. Earth: Armor 3. Water: -1~+1 Range. Wind: +2 Priority.
